quest.title: ...What Do Adventurers Do Again?
quest.description: At Lan's direction, Tiantian of the Adventurers' Guild has been put in charge of distributing commissions, but she has no idea what sort of commissions she should be giving out to adventurers...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x4, Guide to Prosperity x2

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: A—Are you an adventurer? Are you here to accept commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Uh, please... wait a moment, let me see what I have here... "Speed Glider," "Outdoor Survival Experience Guide," "Free Climbing Instructor Wanted..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That doesn't sound like the Adventurers' Guild...

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I know, and Lan says so too! But all the adventures I've read about in books were something like this...

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: If I don't give out these commissions, what should I give out, then...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something like "beat up monsters," perhaps?

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I—Isn't that dangerous? I mean, there are a lot of them around Lisha, and they are a threat to passers-by.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: But normal people don't stand a chance against them. They might even get hurt...

choices.text: Well then, leave it to me.

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Can you really? Well.. Alright then, I'll leave it in your hands. I'll go back and discuss appropriate payment for your services with Lan.

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Is that so... W—Well then, I'll let you handle it. I'll discuss your payment with Lan later.

talks.objective: Defeat all opponents and clear the obstacles

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Was there anything else?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you found that sword of yours?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: ...Huh, to think you still remember that. Unfortunately, no. I still don't have the foggiest idea where it might be.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: It seems I'm still at square one, waiting for things to happen.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: If anything related to that matter crops up, I might come looking for you — When that happens, I'll be counting on you.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Eh? You're back already? Have you completed the commission?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Done, and done!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: That's... really impressive. I went back to the Guild to reorganize our commissions based on the one I gave you.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: There was a whole mountain of commissions related to defeating monsters. So adventurers are supposed to do this sort of thing all the time...

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: But other than monsters, there've been reports that say that Treasure Hoarders have been seen along the roads.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Is this really also something the Adventurers' Guild should do? It feels like it falls under the job scope of the Millelith...

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Huh. Adventurers can really do anything, it seems.

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Well then, I will prepare adequate compensation for you — so please take this commission, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What, another one already? We haven't gotten our...

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: There'll be further compensation! I've already discussed this with Lan. So as long as you complete the next commission, you'll receive further payment.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, that sounds more like it.

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: I'll be counting on you, then.

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: The secret method Lan taught me to "get adventurers to take commissions gladly" really works...

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Adventurers really are impressive... It seems like you can do almost anything.

talks.objective: Defeat the Treasure Hoarders in Lisha

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Do all adventurers do these dangerous things?

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: But what if they get injured...

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Have you finished the commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You bet I have.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Wow... So this is the strength of an adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Well, um, if you don't mind, could you answer some of my questions about adventurers and commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Other than defeating monsters, what other commissions do adventurers take?

choices.text: We also help people fix carts and houses.

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Whoa, doesn't that just mean that you adventurers do everything? I never knew.

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Thank you! I'll make note of it for sure... Ah yes, right. This is your repayment, please take it. It's as generous as can be, you know!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Next time you're here to take commissions from me, I'll make sure to give you the best ones!

choices.text: We help people pick flowers and catch fish.
We send takeout and play with children.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I'll leave it to you then, adventurer!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: The secret method Lan taught me to "get adventurers to take commissions gladly" really works...
